verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows Medusa in the MCP server role: it hosts a docs MCP server at docs.medusajs.com/mcp that external AI agents connect to. Nothing shows Medusa, or its Cloud Development Agent, acting as an MCP client that can plug in external MCP servers and use their tools. The axis plausibly applies to a commerce platform with an agent offering, so absence of evidence yields none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
